title: User preferences, workspace branding, and notification policy
accessibility: Tabs, toggles, color controls, and save feedback expose names and states
Focus remains visible and returns predictably after dialogs
Brand contrast is validated for the public player
Automated critical and serious accessibility violations equal zero
securityInvariants: Only authorized workspace roles can change shared branding
A caller cannot select another tenant notification recipient
Secrets and provider credentials never enter client state or health output
persistence: Saved preferences and branding survive reload, new browser session, and another device
Notification opt-out is enforced by every delivery adapter
concurrency: Concurrent preference edits use version or conflict semantics
Duplicate send requests produce one durable delivery intent
degradedDependencies: Email outage queues or records a retryable failure
Messaging outage does not claim delivery
Brand asset storage outage preserves the previous active brand
rollback: Brand changes can restore the previous published configuration
Notification policy migrations preserve explicit opt-outs
